messages:
Noah: hey folks — spontaneous idea: 'Cozy Window Snap' contest. decorate a tiny window scene on your desk or window sill, snap a pic, win a mystery snack box :camera_with_flash::cookie:
Zara: omg yes. can remote folks participate? i'll be remote that week.
Riley: remote totally welcome. remote-bot can collect photos and we can have a remote winner category.
remote-bot: Remote entry instructions: upload photo to this thread or DM me. Include a 1-line caption and your timezone.
Noah: thinking themes: 'snowy night', 'mini-read nook', 'festive plants'. keep it family-friendly and non-political.
Zara: logistics: deadline Sunday 8pm PT. winners announced Monday AM. cool?
Riley: :thumbsup: Also tiny prize for 'coziest LED setup' and 'most creative repurposed materials'.
Noah: Facilities, any chance for a few clip-on LED strips to loan? they could make small scenes pop.
Facilities: Facilities: We have 10 clip LEDs and a handful of battery tealights. We'll place a sign-out sheet at Reception Friday. Please return by Tuesday.
Zara: safety note: ops-bot, reminder about battery disposal and no open flames?
ops-bot: Reminder: no candles or open flames in office spaces. Use battery LEDs only. Recycle batteries properly: https://intranet/redwood/battery-disposal :information_source:
Riley: i'm volunteering to judge the 'creative repurpose' category. Noah you do 'cozy vibes', Zara you pick 'photography'. agree?
Noah: perfect. judges: Riley (repurpose), me (cozy), Zara (photo). Remote-bot will tally remote votes and shortlist.
Zara: tagging remote folks: we're shipping tiny kits (mini LED + washi + instructions) if you want one. DM me address by Thursday.
Noah: can confirm snacks will include at least one vegan option. anyone allergic to nuts? call out here.
Riley: nuts allergy in my household, will label things. thanks.
Zara: posting sign-up form: https://forms.gle/example  include remote kit request and allergies.
Noah: hashtag for posts: #cozywindow2026. post a caption and what inspired your scene (one line).
Riley: preemptive kudos to Facilities and ops-bot for the LEDs and reminders :clap:
ops-bot: Kudos recorded. Facilities tagged. +1 holiday-support.
